snippet.title: THE CORRIDOR Trailer
snippet.description:
THE CORRIDOR is not just a place. It is the heavy, fragile space where we are forced to stand when life is completely out of our hands. 
It is a story about the agonizing wait, the stubborn grip of hope, and the quiet, breaking moments where life teaches us what it truly means to be grateful.

While one woman stands in  stillness, waiting for the single piece of news that could shatter or save her world, the lives unfolding around her become a mirror. In that cold hallway, she is forced to strip away every distraction and confront her deepest fears, her shaking faith, the family she holds dear, and the beautiful, ordinary things she never realized she had taken for granted.

Produced by: Moromoluwatiketike Abolaji
Directed by: John Oguntuase
Written by: Ade Smith 

THE CORRIDOR premieres September 26, 2025 on YouTube.
